en_title: Warhammer 40,000 Animated Series Produced by Henry Cavill to Tell a 'Long-Form Story' Featuring The Deathwatch
subtitle: 长篇故事启动
opus_summary: 亚马逊正在开发的Warhammer 40,000动画剧集将围绕精英太空陆战队Deathwatch讲述长篇故事，Henry Cavill担任执行制片人。剧集源自《Secret Level》相关集数，可能早于真人版项目播出。

paragraphs.en: The Warhammer 40,000 animated series in development by Amazon will tell a "long-form story" featuring The Deathwatch, with Henry Cavill set to serve as an executive producer.
paragraphs.cn: 亚马逊正在开发的战锤40K动画剧集将围绕死亡守望讲述「长篇故事」，Henry Cavill将担任执行制片人。

paragraphs.en: The series will begin as a spinoff from the Warhammer 40,000 episode of Secret Level, Amazon's animated anthology series that aired back in 2024, Amazon announced previously . The episode's director Dave Wilson will now serve as this new series' director and co-creator, alongside Band of Brothers writer John Orloff. Animation will once again be handled by Blur Studios.
paragraphs.cn: 亚马逊此前宣布，该剧将从其动画选集《秘密关卡》的战锤40K篇章衍生而来；这部选集曾于2024年播出。该集导演Dave Wilson将担任新剧导演和联合创作者，Band of Brothers编剧John Orloff也会参与创作。动画将再次由Blur Studios负责。

paragraphs.en: This is on top of a further Warhammer episode of Secret Level set to debut in the series' upcoming second season, though set in the Warhammer: Age of Sigmar universe.
paragraphs.cn: 此外，《秘密关卡》即将推出的第二季还会有另一集Warhammer篇章，不过故事背景将设在战锤：西格玛时代宇宙。

paragraphs.en: Details of what Amazon's full animated series will feature remain thin on the ground, other than it starring elite alien-hunting Space Marine group The Deathwatch. Exactly how many episodes the series will feature remains to be seen, though Wilson has described the project as a "long-form story" set in the Warhammer 40,000 universe.
paragraphs.cn: 除了主角是精英外星猎杀太空陆战队组织死亡守望之外，亚马逊这部完整动画剧集的内容细节仍然很少。剧集究竟会有多少集也尚未确定，不过Wilson已将项目描述为一部设定于战锤40K宇宙中的「长篇故事」。

paragraphs.en: "Secret Level wasn't conceived simply as an anthology," Wilson told Variety . "It was designed as a launchpad for larger stories. The response to the Warhammer episode was extraordinary, particularly from fans who understood how much care went into getting the world right.
paragraphs.cn: Wilson告诉《综艺》：「《秘密关卡》的构想并不只是做一部选集。它被设计成更大故事的发射台。观众对Warhammer篇章的反响非常热烈，尤其是那些明白我们为准确呈现这个世界投入了多少心力的粉丝。」

paragraphs.en: "This series gives us the opportunity to build on that foundation and tell a much larger story. I've wanted to tell a long-form story set in Warhammer 40,000 for more than 20 years, and I'm incredibly grateful to Games Workshop and Amazon MGM Studios for the opportunity to do it."
paragraphs.cn: 「这部剧让我们有机会在那一基础上继续拓展，讲述一个规模大得多的故事。20多年来，我一直想讲述一个设定于战锤40K的长篇故事，非常感谢Games Workshop和Amazon MGM Studios给我这个机会。」

paragraphs.en: Warhammer 40,000 is already set to become a live-action series, with Amazon and Cavill still working on that. Indeed, we recently learned that horror maestro Mike Flanagan is now on board the project too . But with a script for that still to be written, there's a possibility that this new project may end up debuting first.
paragraphs.cn: 战锤40K已经确定将改编成真人剧集，亚马逊和Cavill仍在推进该项目。我们最近还得知，恐怖片大师Mike Flanagan也已加入其中。不过，由于真人版仍在等待剧本，眼下这部新项目有可能反而先行播出。

paragraphs.en: Amazon's other game-related projects include its Fallout series, upcoming Tomb Raider show starring Game of Thrones' Sophie Turner, a God of War series that's currently going through some cast changes , and a Life of Strange adaptation that is currently filming.
paragraphs.cn: 亚马逊其他与游戏相关的项目包括《辐射》剧集、由《权力的游戏》演员Sophie Turner主演的《Tomb Raider》新剧、正在经历选角变动的《战神》剧集，以及目前正在拍摄的《奇异人生》改编剧。
